messages.author: 21b017a58b9d207c
messages.subject: gcrma
parts:
Hi.  I have success with the following code to do rma background correction (on simple expression data):
> bc <- RmaBackgroundCorrection(cs)
> csBC <- process(bc)
> 

But when I do a similar thing to GcRMA background correct then I get an error: 
> gbc <- GcRmaBackgroundCorrection(cs)
> csGBC <- process(gbc)
Error in basename(path) : a character vector argument expected
>
 
Thanks for any suggestions about what might be different with the latter procedure.  kv
 
Karen Vranizan

messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Re: gcrma
parts:
Hi,

you need to have the Affymetrix probe_tab file available under the
annotationData/ path. Please see the aroma.affymetrix Pages for more
help.

For the next release, I've update the package to give a more
informative error message (as intended).

Cheers

Henrik
